title: Post-Holiday Takedown Lag
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holidaytimer:event
| search event_type="takedown"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by zone_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which zoness have gone quiet for holiday takedown events.
value: Takedown lag is a gentle reality check on whether seasonal setups are being closed out cleanly.
implementation: Send holiday takedown events events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of zoness with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which zoness have gone quiet longer than they should for holiday takedown events.
